title: Concise Book on Ansible, Hands-on Edition
author: Khaled Mahmud
description: A concise, diagram-rich guide to Ansible: the control node and managed nodes, ad-hoc commands and modules, inventories, playbooks, variables and facts, Jinja2 templates, conditions, loops and error handling, handlers and tags, roles and collections, Vault, rolling updates, network automation with FRR, and a hardened, verified web stack. Every example follows one company, Northwind, and runs on DockerLab.
